meta.source: data/affordable-housing/properties.json (unified LIHTC + preservation + HUD MF + USDA RD)
meta.notes: Per-county rollup uses the property's county_fips field. CHFA Preservation records carry no county code in their source; the properties build sets one from each record's coordinates (county_fips_method 'point-in-county'), so county subtotals include them. Town rollups match on the city name, so public housing (HUD gives no city) counts in county and state totals only.
